description: Question type taxonomy for Strategy-Routed GraphRAG. Each type maps to: (1) router detection rules, (2) generation template for autogen QA, (3) preferred retrieval strategy, (4) gold answer format.

strategies.lookup: BM25+Vector+RRF (current pipeline) — fastest path, for 1-hop factoid
strategies.path_plan: Relation-path planning (RoG-style) — multi-hop chains, planner emits relation sequence
strategies.exhaustive: Type-pool exhaustive retrieval — pull ALL triples matching (?, relation, constraint) without top-k cutoff
strategies.complement: Complement / closed-world check — verify absence by enumerating positive evidence then explicit gap report
strategies.dual_subgraph: Two parallel exhaustive retrievals on two entities, then set-aligned compare
strategies.constrained_join: Multi-relation joint constraint — first narrow by most-selective constraint, then validate others

single_hop.description: Direct (head, relation, ?) or (?, relation, tail) factoid. Tail can be entity or literal.

examples.q_zh: AN/TPY-2是由哪家公司研制的？
AN/SPY-1的工作频段是？
examples.q_en: What is the frequency band of AN/SPY-1?

two_hop_bridge.description: Bridge over a middle entity: (head, r1, m) ∧ (m, r2, ?). Common pattern: deployed-on platform → operated-by country.
two_hop_bridge.gen_template: (head, r1, m), (m, r2, ?)  — emit question that requires traversing m

examples.q_zh: AN/TPY-2的研制厂商所属于哪个国家？

three_hop_chain.description: Three-relation chain. Rare in radar domain but useful for stress-testing planner.

examples.q_zh: AN/APG-82的前代型号由哪个国家的公司研制？

relation_inverse.description: Question asks for the subject: (?, relation, tail). Multi-valued by nature.

examples.q_zh: Raytheon研制了哪些雷达？
工作在S波段的雷达有哪些？

agg_count.description: Count: how many entities satisfy a condition. Strategy MUST be exhaustive — top-k truncation is fatal.

examples.q_zh: 美国共有多少款X波段雷达？
Lockheed Martin研制了多少型雷达？

agg_enum.description: List-all: enumerate all entities satisfying a condition. Recall-critical, top-k must be removed.

examples.q_zh: 列出所有部署在阿利·伯克级驱逐舰上的雷达。
美国所有能兼容AIM-120的雷达？

set_compare.description: Compare two entities along a relation: intersection / difference / common attribute.

examples.q_zh: AN/SPY-1和AN/SPY-6的共同部署平台？
AN/TPY-2和AN/MPQ-65的研制公司是同一家吗？

negation.description: Find entities NOT satisfying a condition, or verify absence of a relation. Most failure-prone in factoid-only RAG.
negation.answer_format: list of entities OR yes/no with justification
negation.gen_template: Find {target_type} NOT satisfying ({constraint}); answer must be grounded by enumerating positive evidence first.

examples.q_zh: AN/SPY-6不部署在哪些平台上？
examples.a: (among the platforms in KG, list those without deployedOn link to AN/SPY-6)

examples.q_zh: AN/TPY-2有没有出口到中国？
examples.a: 否（KG中无AN/TPY-2 exportedTo 中国 三元组）

attr_filter.description: Multi-relation joint constraint: filter by 2+ attributes simultaneously. The planner must do AND-join across relations.

examples.q_zh: 工作在S波段且由日本研制的舰载雷达？
美国研制的且部署在阿利·伯克级上的雷达？

unanswerable.description: KG does not contain the answer. The system MUST refuse rather than hallucinate.
router_signals_zh: trick: include radar names not in KG

examples.q_zh: AN/SPY-99的研制单位？
AN/TPY-2的造价是多少？
examples.a: 未知（KG中无AN/TPY-2 price 三元组）

distractor.description: Surface-similar entities that confuse retrieval (AN/SPY-1 vs AN/SPY-1A vs AN/SPY-1D). Tests entity disambiguation.

examples.q_zh: AN/SPY-1A的频段是？(注意：和AN/SPY-1区分)
AN/APG-68(V)9的部署平台？(注意：和AN/APG-68区分)

router_prompt_template:
你是一个雷达知识图谱问答系统的查询分类器。给定一个中文或英文问题，输出最匹配的题型ID（必须从以下列表选一个）：
- single_hop: 直接事实查询
- two_hop_bridge: 需要桥接中间实体的两跳查询
- three_hop_chain: 三跳链式查询
- relation_inverse: 反向查询（已知客体找主体）
- agg_count: 计数题
- agg_enum: 列举题
- set_compare: 比较两个实体
- negation: 否定/排除题
- attr_filter: 多约束筛选题
- unanswerable: KG无法回答
- distractor: 易混淆实体题

问题：{question}

仅输出题型ID，不要其他内容。

validation_priorities.decision_gate: If after the 30-question minimal validation, agg_count + agg_enum + negation strategies do NOT show >=15% absolute improvement over current pipeline, reconsider before scaling to 500-question benchmark.
validation_priorities.rationale: These three are where the strategy-routing thesis lives or dies. single_hop and two_hop_bridge are not differentiators (existing GraphRAG already strong on them).
